name: Alpha Prime
description: Alpha Prime is a singleplayer first-person shooter game.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX and sound occlusion
audio_settings.reason: Out of the box, Alpha Prime has EAX and sound occlusion turned on.

audio_settings.title: Enable Stereo output
audio_settings.reason: The game has a Speakers setting in settings.cfg. This sets it to 2, which is stereo output.

audio_settings.title: Enable headphone output
audio_settings.reason: Alpha Prime's sound output defaults to a speaker layout, so headphones get a mix made for speakers. Setting Speakers to 4 in settings.cfg switches it to the headphone output.

audio_settings.title: Enable Surround Sound output
audio_settings.reason: The game sets its speaker output to stereo by default. Setting Speakers to 5 selects 5.1 surround, which suits a matrix-encoded surround setup.

audio_settings.title: Enable 4.0 surround output
audio_settings.reason: With quad speakers, the game's sound setting is not set to the quad mode. The rear speakers can stay silent or play the wrong channels.

audio_settings.title: Enable 5.1 surround output
audio_settings.reason: The game's Speakers setting is not set to 6 by default, so it does not use all six channels of a 5.1 setup. Setting it to 6 makes the game send surround sound to a 5.1 speaker system.

audio_settings.title: Enable 7.1 surround output
audio_settings.reason: The game's Speakers option defaults to a lower channel count. Setting it to 7 makes the game send 7.1 sound to OpenAL Soft.

notes: Alpha Prime sets its speaker option back to stereo every time it starts, so the speaker settings offered later don't last. That happened with Proton's default PipeWire audio driver, and with a 7.1 output on the PulseAudio driver.
